content: {"praised":["Beautiful scenery and evocative photography.","Atmospheric settings and decent thesping.","Good humor and historical accuracy.","Strong acting, especially Glenn Morshower and Henry Thomas.","Superb music and visuals pure Texas."],"criticized":["Plot disjointed, storylines never converge.","Characters sketchy, obstacles lackluster.","Choppy editing and horrible cinematography.","Confused narrative, unclear good vs bad.","Unwatchable, pacing issues."]}
